title: E1K, a disease-modifying drug candidate for knee osteoarthritis, alleviates pain and regenerates cartilage simultaneously by inhibiting TGF-beta1-mediated SMAD1/5/9 signaling in osteoarthritis models.
authors: Moon, Eun-Joung; Kim, Ji Ae; Jang, Yunsil; Kim, Hyeon-Jeong; Park, Sang-Je; Lee, Cheolmin; Kang, Nam Sook; Kim, Hae-Jin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究E1K肽通过抑制TGF-beta1介导的SMAD信号治疗骨关节炎，虽含分子对接但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1) signaling is critical in joint homeostasis and osteoarthritis (OA) pathogenesis. Engedi 1000 (E1K), a novel short peptide, is a selective modulator of TGF-beta1-induced SMAD1/5/9 signaling. We evaluated the analgesic and structure-modifying effects of E1K in OA models. DESIGN: The binding of E1K and TGF-beta1 were investigated using molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR). The molecular effects of E1K were examined in human chondrocytes and bovine fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS). Analgesia was assessed in a monosodium iodoacetate (MIA)-induced OA rat model using the von Frey test. Structure modification were evaluated in an anterior cruciate ligament transection (ACLT)-induced OA rabbit model by OARSI scoring and immunohistochemistry (type II collagen, MMP13, ALK1, and ALK5). RESULTS: Molecular docking predicted, and SPR confirmed E1K binding to TGF-beta1. In human chondrocytes, E1K selectively inhibited TGF-beta1-induced SMAD1/5/9 signaling while preserving SMAD2/3 phosphorylation. It downregulated catabolic markers (MMP13, COL10A1), while COL2A1 remained unchanged. In bovine FLS, E1K significantly inhibited TGF-beta1-induced NGF expression. In the MIA model, E1K significantly reduced mechanical allodynia at highest dose. In the ACLT model, E1K improved the cartilage integrity, reduced the OARSI score, and decreased the ALK1/ALK5 expression ratio. CONCLUSIONS: E1K promoted TGF-beta1 signaling toward an anabolic profile by inhibiting catabolic signaling and regenerating cartilage, suggesting its potential as a disease-modifying osteoarthritis drug candidate with dual efficacy in pain relief and structural protection.
abstract_zh: 目的：转化生长因子-β1（TGF-beta1）信号在关节稳态和骨关节炎（OA）发病机制中至关重要。Engedi 1000（E1K）是一种新型短肽，是TGF-beta1诱导的SMAD1/5/9信号的选择性调节剂。我们评估了E1K在OA模型中的镇痛和结构修饰作用。设计：通过分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）研究E1K与TGF-beta1的结合。在人类软骨细胞和牛成纤维样滑膜细胞（FLS）中检测E1K的分子效应。在单碘乙酸（MIA）诱导的OA大鼠模型中，使用von Frey试验评估镇痛效果。在前交叉韧带横断（ACLT）诱导的OA兔模型中，通过OARSI评分和免疫组化（II型胶原、MMP13、ALK1和ALK5）评估结构修饰。结果：分子对接预测并SPR确认了E1K与TGF-beta1的结合。在人类软骨细胞中，E1K选择性抑制TGF-beta1诱导的SMAD1/5/9信号，同时保留SMAD2/3磷酸化。它下调分解代谢标志物（MMP13、COL10A1），而COL2A1保持不变。在牛FLS中，E1K显著抑制TGF-beta1诱导的NGF表达。在MIA模型中，E1K在最高剂量下显著减少机械性异常性疼痛。在ACLT模型中，E1K改善软骨完整性，降低OARSI评分，并降低ALK1/ALK5表达比率。结论：E1K通过抑制分解代谢信号和再生软骨，促进TGF-beta1信号向合成代谢方向转变，表明其作为疾病修饰性骨关节炎候选药物具有镇痛和结构保护的双重功效潜力。
